_comment: Gallery configuration. Re-read on every request, so edit and refresh to see changes - no restart needed. Everything is optional: a patch not listed here still appears, in the default category, previewed with its own defaults.

categories.name: Cell patterns
categories.description: The page is divided into convex cells and each one is filled independently. Blue-noise sampling keeps the cells evenly sized, so there are no slivers and no awkward leftovers. Cell size is the main control; the fill decides the character.

categories.name: Field patterns
categories.description: A noise landscape is sampled across the whole sheet and traced directly, with no subdivision at all. The result is a few long flowing curves rather than many short strokes, which plots quickly and reads as organic rather than constructed.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Patches that have not been placed in a category yet.
